title: Qt: Update Capture, Display Filter Entry translation on lang change
description:
Update the translated strings in the FilterExpressionEdit and
its subclasses CaptureFilterEntry and DisplayFilterEntry on language
change.

The context menus are created on demand and destroyed, but everything
else needs to update when the language changes, especially because some
of these are present in the main window and not temporary dialogs, so
otherwise they would be incorrect until restarting the entire program.

Ping #21295
